# PayVault

> Payment infrastructure for unreliable networks. PayVault lets licensed partners (banks, mobile money operators, fintechs, PSPs) offer payments that work with no network: a pre-funded offline vault plus an optional offline overdraft, settled automatically when a device reconnects. PayVault is a technology provider. It is not a bank or a wallet and never holds customer funds. Available in English and French.

Offline double-spending is bounded by vault limits, detected at settlement through hash-chain fork detection, and recovered from the KYC-verified holder, with a risk pool as backstop. It is not claimed to be impossible.

## Product
- [Product](https://payvault-phi.vercel.app/en/product): the two layers, reliability and guaranteed offline acceptance
- [How it works](https://payvault-phi.vercel.app/en/how-it-works): allowance lifecycle and the two-scan payment flow
- [Pay later](https://payvault-phi.vercel.app/en/pay-later): the offline overdraft and how it is repaid
- [Pricing](https://payvault-phi.vercel.app/en/pricing): integration, platform, usage and support
- [Security](https://payvault-phi.vercel.app/en/security): threat model and custody
